proposals.quote: Through the partnership, Bally’s employees will have free access to Upwards’ expansive network of in-home daycare providers and caregivers. The program is designed to connect working parents and guardians with quality, reliable, and affordable childcare options — all while accommodating the non-traditional work hours of many casino and resort employees.

Upwards’ Dedicated Care Managers will be available around the clock to help Bally’s employees source the best local childcare options, set up tours and interviews, facilitate enrollment, and support families once children begin care.

“Bally’s Corporation is proud to partner with Upwards and offer a convenient childcare solution for our Bally’s Casinos & Resorts family. We want our team members to focus on their families and careers without having a concern around childcare,” said George Papanier, President of Bally’s Casinos & Resorts.

From access to the world’s largest employee discount network to 401k retirement opportunities and investment consultation, Bally’s is vested in the personal success our team members and offers the following to all full-time employees:
